name: Legion (VST3, in development)
description: One voice in, a choir of it out. Up to four copies, each with its own pitch AND its own body size, because a voice shifted without separating those two is a chipmunk rather than a singer. FOLLOW decides how much the body rides the note; HUMANISE makes the copies a section rather than a stack. New: the LEVELLER, a clean two-way vocal compressor. It turns the loud parts down, lifts the quiet ones, leaves the noise under the floor alone, and looks ahead for free using the latency Legion already has. Switch every voice off and it is a studio leveller on its own.
note: Windows VST3 · in development · free download · 4 voices · independent pitch and formant · two-way vocal leveller · BWFX rack · source included.
